2607.08056.title: Reinforcing the Generation Order of Multimodal Masked Diffusion Models
2607.08056.paper_summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have recently achieved substantial progress in natural language generation tasks. Recent research demonstrates that adaptive token generation ordering can significantly improve performance in mathematical reasoning and code synthesis applications. In this work, we investigate the optimization of generation order for both text-to-image synthesis and multimodal understanding. We first establish that, unlike structured problems in language generation such as Sudoku puzzles, model logits alone are insufficient for determining optimal generation sequences in text-to-image generation and multimodal understanding. To address this challenge, we introduce a learnable control module trained via Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) to determine the generation order. Our results demonstrate that learning this control block substantially improves both text-to-image alignment and multimodal understanding in DLMs. In particular, it enhances the model's ability to capture fine-grained spatial relationships in generated images while also strengthening performance on multimodal reasoning and comprehension tasks. We evaluate our framework on GenEval, an object-focused benchmark for text-to-image alignment, where it achieves 4.08% relative improvements. In addition, experiments on VLMEvalKit confirm 4.85% relative improvements in multimodal understanding, highlighting the broad effectiveness of our approach.
2607.08056.paper_summary_zh: 擴散語言模型（DLMs）最近在自然語言生成任務中取得了顯著進展。最近的研究表明，自適應的標記生成順序可以顯著提高數學推理和代碼合成應用中的性能。在這項工作中，我們研究了文本到圖像合成和多模態理解的生成順序優化。我們首先確立，與語言生成中的結構性問題（如數獨謎題）不同，僅依賴模型邏輯值不足以確定文本到圖像生成和多模態理解中的最佳生成序列。為了解決這一挑戰，我們引入了一個可學習的控制模塊，通過群體相對策略優化（GRPO）進行訓練，以確定生成順序。我們的結果表明，學習這個控制模塊顯著改善了DLMs中的文本到圖像對齊和多模態理解。特別是，它增強了模型捕捉生成圖像中細緻空間關係的能力，同時加強了在多模態推理和理解任務上的表現。我們在GenEval上評估了我們的框架，這是一個以物體為重點的文本到圖像對齊基準，達到了4.08%的相對改進。此外，在VLMEvalKit上的實驗確認了多模態理解的4.85%相對改進，突顯了我們方法的廣泛有效性。
